body: Iraq: flag – three horizontal stripes red, white, black with the green Kufic 'الله أكبر' in the white stripe. Look – flat golden plains, the Tigris and Euphrates lined with date palms, buff-brick cities, mosque domes in turquoise and gold, the green north (Kurdistan mountains) and the southern marshes. People greet with 'هلا', 'شلونك', 'الله بالخير'; address elders as 'حجي/حجية', friends as 'أخي', 'عيوني', 'حبيبي'.

Saudi Arabia: flag – green with the white shahada and a sword. Look – Riyadh's glass towers (Kingdom Centre with its bottle-opener top, Al Faisaliah's globe), wide highways, desert dunes, Jeddah's coral-stone old houses with wooden rawasheen balconies and the Red Sea corniche; Makkah's Grand Mosque and Kaaba (treat with great respect). Men in white thobe and red-white shemagh, women in black abaya. Greeting: 'السلام عليكم', 'هلا والله', 'يا هلا'.

UAE: flag – vertical red bar at the hoist with green, white, black horizontal stripes. Look – Dubai's Burj Khalifa (needle-thin stepped tower, tallest in the world), Burj Al Arab sail, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina towers and yachts, luxury malls, Abu Dhabi's white Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque with many domes and reflecting pools; desert safari with red dunes. Greeting: 'مرحبا', 'هلا', 'شحالك'.

Kuwait: flag – green, white, red horizontal stripes with a black trapezoid at the hoist. Look – the Kuwait Towers (blue-green sequined spheres on needles) on the Gulf, Liberation Tower, modern malls, Souq Al-Mubarakiya. Greeting: 'هلا', 'شلونك', 'شخبارك'.

Qatar: flag – maroon with a white serrated band (nine points) at the hoist. Look – Doha's West Bay skyline of futuristic towers, the Museum of Islamic Art on the corniche, Souq Waqif with mud-plaster walls and lanterns, the Pearl island, stadiums. Greeting: 'هلا والله', 'شلونك'.

Jordan: flag – black, white, green horizontal stripes with a red triangle and a white seven-pointed star. Look – Amman's hills covered in white limestone houses, the Roman theatre and Citadel, Petra's rose-red Treasury carved into the cliff at the end of the Siq canyon, Wadi Rum's red desert, the Dead Sea. Greeting: 'مرحبا', 'كيفك', 'يا هلا'.

Syria: flag – green, white, black horizontal stripes with three red stars in the white (current flag). Look – old Damascus with narrow stone alleys, wooden bay windows, courtyard houses with jasmine and fountains, the Umayyad Mosque, souq Al-Hamidiyah's arched metal roof with light holes. Greeting: 'مرحبا', 'كيفك', 'أهلين'.

Lebanon: flag – red, white, red horizontal bands with a green cedar tree in the centre. Look – Beirut's Mediterranean corniche and Raouché Pigeon Rocks, old French-era buildings with balconies next to modern towers, mountains with cedar forests and red-roofed villages, Byblos harbour. Greeting: 'مرحبا', 'كيفك', 'Bonjour/هاي' mixed.

Egypt: flag – red, white, black horizontal stripes with the golden Eagle of Saladin in the centre. Look – the Giza pyramids and the Sphinx on the desert edge with Cairo behind, the Nile with feluccas (white triangular sails), crowded Cairo streets with minarets, Khan el-Khalili bazaar, Alexandria's corniche. Greeting: 'إزيك', 'أهلاً', 'يا باشا', 'يا فندم'.

Turkey: flag – red with a white crescent and star. Look – Istanbul's skyline of domes and pencil minarets (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia), the Bosphorus with ferries and the bridge, Galata Tower, colourful houses in Balat, simit sellers, tea in tulip glasses; Cappadocia's hot-air balloons over rock chimneys. Greeting: 'Merhaba', 'Nasılsın'.

Iran: flag – green, white, red horizontal stripes with the red emblem in the centre. Look – Isfahan's Naqsh-e Jahan square with blue-tiled domes and arches, Tehran with the Milad and Azadi towers against the Alborz mountains, Persian gardens with long pools. Greeting: 'Salam', 'Khubi?'.

Morocco: flag – red with a green five-pointed star outline. Look – Marrakech's terracotta walls, Jemaa el-Fnaa square with food stalls and lanterns at night, riads with zellige mosaic tiles and fountains, Chefchaouen's blue streets, the Hassan II Mosque on the ocean in Casablanca. Greeting: 'السلام', 'لاباس', 'مرحبا'.

USA: flag – 13 red and white stripes with 50 white stars on a blue canton. Look – New York's Manhattan skyline (Empire State, One World Trade), yellow cabs, Times Square billboards, brownstones; Los Angeles palm-lined boulevards and the Hollywood sign; Washington's white Capitol dome. Greeting: 'Hey', 'Hi, how are you?'.

UK: flag – the Union Jack (red and white crosses over blue). Look – London's Big Ben and Parliament on the Thames, Tower Bridge, red double-decker buses and red phone boxes, black cabs, rows of brick terraced houses, grey drizzly sky. Greeting: 'Hello', 'Alright?', 'Cheers'.

France: flag – vertical blue, white, red stripes. Look – Paris with the iron lattice Eiffel Tower, cream Haussmann buildings with grey zinc roofs and wrought-iron balconies, cafés with small round tables on pavements, the Seine with stone bridges, the Louvre glass pyramid. Greeting: 'Bonjour', 'Salut', a light double cheek kiss among friends.

Germany: flag – black, red, gold horizontal stripes. Look – Berlin's Brandenburg Gate, the glass Reichstag dome, clean streets with bike lanes, half-timbered old towns, Munich beer gardens. Greeting: 'Hallo', 'Guten Tag'.

Italy: flag – vertical green, white, red stripes. Look – Rome's Colosseum and fountains, narrow cobbled streets with Vespas, Venice canals with gondolas and arched bridges, Milan's Gothic cathedral; warm ochre walls and green shutters. Greeting: 'Ciao', 'Buongiorno'.

Spain: flag – red, yellow (wide), red horizontal bands with the coat of arms. Look – Barcelona's Sagrada Família with organic spires, Gaudí's mosaic Park Güell, Madrid's grand plazas, Andalusia's white villages and the Alhambra's Moorish arches. Greeting: 'Hola', '¿Qué tal?'.

Japan: flag – white with a red circle. Look – Tokyo's neon Shibuya crossing with crowds, tidy narrow streets with vending machines, Kyoto temples and red torii gates, cherry blossoms in spring, Mount Fuji's snow-capped cone. Greeting: a bow, 'Konnichiwa'.

China: flag – red with one large and four small yellow stars. Look – Shanghai's Bund and Pudong skyline (Oriental Pearl Tower), Beijing's Forbidden City with red walls and golden roofs, the Great Wall over green mountains, red lanterns. Greeting: 'Nǐ hǎo'.

India: flag – saffron, white, green horizontal stripes with a navy-blue 24-spoke wheel. Look – the white marble Taj Mahal with its reflecting pool, busy colourful streets with rickshaws, spice markets, Mumbai's Gateway of India. Greeting: 'Namaste' with palms together.

Russia: flag – white, blue, red horizontal stripes. Look – Moscow's Red Square with the colourful onion domes of St Basil's Cathedral and the red Kremlin walls, snowy winters, wide avenues. Greeting: 'Privet', 'Zdravstvuyte'.

Brazil: flag – green with a yellow diamond and a blue globe with stars and a white band. Look – Rio's Christ the Redeemer statue on Corcovado above the bay, Sugarloaf Mountain, Copacabana beach with wavy promenade tiles, colourful favelas on hills, carnival. Greeting: 'Olá', 'Tudo bem?'.

Kurdistan Region of Iraq: flag – red, white, green horizontal stripes with a golden 21-ray sun in the centre. Look – green mountains and valleys, waterfalls (Gali Ali Beg), Erbil's ancient Citadel on its mound, Sulaymaniyah's mountain backdrop, picnics by rivers at Newroz with fires and line dancing. Greeting in Kurdish: 'Choni?', 'Bash', 'Sipas'.
